title: Amazingly Caramelized Jamaican Haddock Skewers
description: A salty and silky meal prep dish featuring haddock, caramelized to perfection, served on a cedar plank, this Jamaican inspired recipe is a must try for seafood lovers, with a raw friendly option available
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together brown sugar, soy sauce, lime juice, and olive oil
Add jerk seasoning and garlic powder to the bowl and whisk until combined
Add the haddock pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade
Thread the marinated haddock pieces onto the soaked cedar planks
Place the cedar planks on the grill and cook for 8-10 minutes per side
After flipping the haddock, brush with additional marinade if desired
Once cooked, let the haddock rest for 2 minutes before serving
Serve immediately, garnished with fresh parsley or scallions if desired
